plan.summary: Fix race condition in concurrent add operations using optimistic concurrency with retry on ID collision
plan.approach: Implement optimistic concurrency control in TodoApp.add() - detect ID collision after save and retry with a new ID if collision detected

tdd_sequence.description: Create failing regression test that simulates concurrent add() operations and verifies no duplicate IDs
Add optimistic concurrency retry logic to TodoApp.add() method
Run tests and linting to confirm fix

risks: Retry mechanism could theoretically loop infinitely under extreme contention (mitigated by max retry limit)
Performance impact under high concurrency (acceptable for typical CLI usage)
